units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 15:9">Targ. O. Gen. XV, 9</cite> <cite ref="V00628"><he>תְּלָתָה</he></cite> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <cite ref="V00627"><he>תִּלְתָּא</he></cite>, read <cite ref="V00626"><he>תְּלָתָא</he></cite>); Targ. Y.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 29:3">Ib. XXIX, 3</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 87a:1">Sabb. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>בת׳</he> (sub. <he>בשבא</he>) on the third day of the week.
<cite ref="Shabbat 36a:2">Ib. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>הני ת׳ מילי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U01586"><he>שְׁנֵי</he></cite>.
Meg. 6ᵇ ת׳ מאה וכ׳, v. תָּגָא; a. v. fr.—תלת עסר (תלתא), ת׳ עשר, ת׳ עשרה, תְּלֵיסַר, תְּלֵיסְרֵי, תִּלְתֵּיסַר thirteen.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 14:4">Targ. Gen. XIV, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:5-7">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא … תליסרי שנין</he> whom he had not seen for thirteen years.
Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ לסוף תלת עשרתי וכ׳ at the end of thirteen years and thirty days; a. fr.—Pl. תְּלָתִין thirty.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 5:3">Targ. Gen. V, 3</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 98b:9">Sabb. 98ᵇ</cite>. Y. Kil. l. c. <he>כל אינון תַּלְתּוֹיֵי יומיא</he> all these thirty days.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>לסוף … ותַלְתָּתוֹי יומייא</he>, v. supra; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ bot. <cite ref="V00637"><he>תַּלְתִּיתֵי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 2a">ib.</cite> <cite ref="V00596"><he>תְּלֵיתִיתֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 9:2:3">Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>תְּלָתִים שנין</he> thirty years; a. fr.
